Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding commercializing research at state universities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to commercializing research at state universities;and adding a new section to chapter 28B.63 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.63 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The mission of the state universities, as defined in RCW28B.10.016, includes commercializing research that benefits theintermediate and longterm economic vitality of Washington anddeveloping and strengthening universityindustry relationships throughthe conduct of research, company and job creation, or state economicdevelopment programs. The state universities shall: (1) Provide leadingedge collaborative research and technologytransfer opportunities; (2) Provide substantial opportunities for training undergraduateand graduate students through direct involvement in research andindustry interactions; and (3) Provide a forum for effective interaction between the state'stechnologybased industries and its academic institutions through p. 1 SB 6594promotion of faculty collaboration with industry, particularly withinWashington.
